Domus Project

By: Oscar

Press a stop to fly the camera to it. Each Latin color phrase matches the room's color in the model. Walls off shows every room at once; the doorways are cut through the walls.

Model built in Blender by Oscar for 6th grade Latin. The signposts marked I to VI in the model match the stops above; the placard beside the pond carries the same text.
